asset_set: Questionnaire Q3 option 1 — Starting an online business

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under shipping box and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; two faint corrugated lines suggesting cardboard edge on box only
art_style.mood: energetic startup-hustle vibe — approachable small-business launch, not corporate boardroom
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame
readable text, shipping labels, or logos

accent.name: KursoKo coral
accent.use: phone growth-arrow icon, packing tape strip, sleeve cuff pinstripe

secondary.name: gold
secondary.use: shipping box corner star sticker, phone case trim

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops only
color.accent_rule: coral appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlight on phone screen edge and tape dispenser
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under hands and box base

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: seals a small shipping box with a strip of tape
left_hand.grip: flat palm pressing the tape strip down
left_hand.position: lower-left quadrant, wrist angled toward center

right_hand.action: holds up a smartphone showing an abstract upward growth-arrow icon
right_hand.grip: loose grip along the phone's edge, thumb near the screen

pose.gesture_summary: mid-launch freeze frame — first order packed while sales notification appears
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of hands packs and seals a small shipping box for a first customer order while a smartphone lights up with an abstract upward growth-arrow icon. A blank shipping label and a small gold star sticker on the box corner suggest a proud milestone moment, capturing the DIY energy of launching a small online shop rather than a corporate office scene.

primary_objects.name: small shipping box
primary_objects.detail: blank shipping label on top, gold star sticker on near corner, coral tape strip being applied

primary_objects.name: smartphone with growth icon
primary_objects.size_relative: medium — held upright in right hand
primary_objects.detail: warm cream screen with a simple coral upward arrow and small bar shapes, no readable text

primary_objects.name: tape dispenser
primary_objects.detail: coral body with visible tape roll edge

subject.environment: light birch desk surface strip across bottom third — fades to transparent at edges, no office backdrop

composition.layout: diagonal workflow line from tape dispenser → shipping box → phone growth icon
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 48px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: desk edge only — no wall
composition.thumbnail_readability: box silhouette + phone shape + two hands readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter E, dollar sign, currency symbols, readable shipping label, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, guns, blood
